title: Bar Ada Savula’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Bava Metzia 93b: he was taking animals over the bridge at Naresh. One pushed another into the water. He came before Rav Papa, who ordered him to pay compensation.
Apparently he was merely a herdsman and was not counted among the Torah scholars.

notes.text: אגמלא means “over the bridge,” not “on camels.” The consulted passage names Naresh and Rav Papa and says that one animal pushed the other into the water. Hyman’s assessment of the herdsman’s scholarly status remains tentative.
The consulted Bava Metzia names Naresh and Rav Papa. The continuation discusses taking the animals across individually.
